definition_zh: 请愿书；申请书；请愿；正式请求；申请
definition_en: a written request signed by many people and sent to an authority, or the act of asking formally for something
core_image: 一沓写满签名的纸被收齐，双手递到官署的桌上
scene: 为了阻止老街区被拆除，居民们挨家挨户收集签名。Hundreds of residents signed a petition against the demolition of the old market.
sceneCN: 这里 petition 是「请愿书」（第 1 个义项：多人签名、递交给当局的书面请求）；句意：数百名居民签署了一份反对拆除老市场的请愿书。

collocations.zh: 提交请愿书；递交申请书

derivatives.zh: petition 去 -ion 加 -er，指「请愿人；申请人」，尤其指离婚申请的一方
petition 加 -ary，指「请愿的；恳求的」，多见于书面语
动词加 -ing 转名词，指「请愿活动；递交请愿」

senses.title: A signed written request to an authority
senses.definition: a written request signed by many people and handed to a government or other authority
senses.definitionCN: 由许多人签名、递交给政府或其它当局的书面请求
senses.example: More than ten thousand people signed the petition to keep the library open.
senses.exampleCN: 超过一万人签署了保留图书馆的请愿书。
senses.why: Latin petere means to seek or go towards something, and a petition is exactly that seeking made visible as paper with names on it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 petere 意为「寻求、奔向」，请愿书正是这种寻求落到纸上、写满名字的样子。

senses.title: A formal application in law or procedure
senses.definition: a formal written application asking a court, official or organization to take an action
senses.definitionCN: 请求法院、官员或机构采取行动的一种正式书面申请
senses.example: The couple filed a petition for divorce last spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这对夫妇去年春天递交了离婚申请。
senses.why: Courts turned the old idea of asking into a fixed document with a name, so the same paper that carries public names also carries a single formal request.
senses.whyCN: 法律把「请求」这个古老动作固定成一份有名目的文书，于是承载众人签名的纸也承载了单个正式的申请。

senses.title: The act of asking on behalf of others
senses.definition: the act of asking an authority for something, often on behalf of a group or community
senses.definitionCN: 向当局提出请求的行为，常代表一群人或不特定的公众
senses.example: Their petition to the city council lasted several months.
senses.exampleCN: 他们向市议会请愿持续了好几个月。
senses.why: As a noun of action, petition names the long asking itself, not just the sheet that carries the request.
senses.whyCN: 作为动作名词，petition 指整个「请求」的过程，而不只是载着请求的那张纸。

senses.title: To ask an authority formally
senses.definition: to make a formal request to a government, court or other body, usually in writing
senses.definitionCN: 向政府、法院或其它机构提出正式请求，通常以书面形式
senses.example: Local farmers petitioned the ministry for better water rights.
senses.exampleCN: 当地农民向部委请愿，要求更公平的水权。
senses.why: The verb keeps the aim of Latin petere, to seek, and directs it at a person or body that has the power to grant or refuse.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留了拉丁语 petere 的「寻求」方向，并把这份寻求对准有权答应或拒绝的人或机构。

senses.title: To appeal for help or understanding
senses.definition: to appeal humbly to someone for help, understanding or change of mind
senses.definitionCN: 谦卑地向某人恳求帮助、理解或改变主意
senses.example: She petitioned the air company to let her change the flight.
senses.exampleCN: 她向航空公司恳求，希望能改签航班。
senses.why: This softer sense drops the formal document and keeps only the Latin stance of a seeker who stands before someone with power.
senses.whyCN: 这一较柔和的义项舍去正式文书，只保留拉丁语中「寻求者站在掌权者面前」的姿态。

intro.en: Petition goes back to Latin petere, to seek or request, through the verb petitionem and Old French peticion.
intro.cn: petition 源自拉丁语 petere（寻求、请求），经动词性名词 petitionem 与古法语 peticion 进入英语。

items.en: *pet- is generally reconstructed as meaning to rush or fly towards something.
items.cn: 一般认为原始印欧语 *pet- 表示「奔向、飞向某物」，这一点较为可信。

items.en: Petere means to seek, aim at or request, and gives petere plus the noun-form -io.
items.cn: 拉丁语 petere 意为寻求、瞄准、请求，加上名词词形 -io 构成 petere 的派生名词。

items.en: Petitio names the act of seeking or asking, and is used for candidates seeking office.
items.cn: petitio 指寻求、请求这一行为，也用于描述候选人谋求公职。

items.en: Peticion carries the request word into French, where it means a formal asking.
items.cn: 古法语 peticion 把这个「请求」词带入法语，意为正式的请求。

items.en: Middle English petition names a prayer or a formal request to a ruler.
items.cn: 中古英语 petition 指祈祷，或指向君主提出的正式请求。

items.en: Modern English adds the court application and the modern campaign of signed petitions.
items.cn: 现代英语又增加了法院申请书，以及以签名请愿开展的社会运动。

note.en: Petition sits beside its Latin family (petere, appetite, compete) and beside the many English words for asking.
note.cn: petition 与它的拉丁词族（petere、appetite、compete）相邻，也与英语中各种表示「请求」的词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who signs or makes a petition
relating to a petition or request
the activity of collecting signatures and asking for change
entries.definitionCN: 请愿活动；征集签名的过程

entries.definition: an urgent or serious request for help
an earnest request made in an emotional way
entries.definitionCN: 恳求；呼吁；法庭上的答辩

entries.definition: a written request for a job, place or official service

normalIntro.en: Petition is Latin petere, to seek: the seeker walks to the door of the powerful and hands over a written ask.
normalIntro.cn: petition 就是拉丁语 petere「寻求」：寻求者走到掌权者的门口，递上一份写好的请求。

normal.en: Sign a petition is the everyday phrase: names on paper are the proof of many voices.
normal.cn: sign a petition 是最常见的说法：纸上的签名就是众声的凭据。

normal.en: Petition for something expects a result, while petition against a plan expects a stop.
normal.cn: petition for something 求一个结果，petition against a plan 则是求叫停。

normal.en: The legal world says file a petition when the request goes to a court.
normal.cn: 法律场合说 file a petition，指把请求递交给法院。

normal.en: Petition shares the Latin root with appetite, a seeking towards food, and compete, a seeking together.
normal.cn: petition 与 appetite（对食物的寻求）、compete（一起追寻）同源，都出自拉丁语「寻求」。

normal.en: Compare application: an application is usually for yourself, a petition is often for a group.
normal.cn: 对比 application：前者多为自己申请，petition 往往代表一群人。

abstract.en: Picture a thick stack of signed pages being handed over a counter.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠签满名字的纸被双手递过柜台。

abstract.en: Imagine a stamped court form with one name in the applicant line.
abstract.cn: 想象一张盖了章的法院表格，申请人一栏只写着一个人的名字。

abstract.en: Think of a crowd standing silently at the gate, holding one shared request.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人安静地站在大门前，共同举着一份请求。

examples.en: The workers started a petition asking for safer night shifts.
examples.cn: 工人们发起了一份请愿，要求夜班更安全。

examples.en: She petitioned the council to improve the bus route near her school.
examples.cn: 她向议会请愿，要求改善学校附近的公交线路。

examples.en: The petition gathered over fifty thousand signatures in a week.
examples.cn: 这份请愿书一周内收集了五万多个签名。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「批特训」——一群人把写好的请求一批批递上去、接受特训般的审查，即请愿；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 petere（寻求、奔向、请求）→ 名词 petitio（寻求、请求）→ 古法语 peticion → 英语 petition。petere 还生出 appetite（渴求）、compete（竞相追求）、petulant 等词；更早的原始印欧语 *pet-「奔向」一般认为成立。

sensesIntro.en: Petition moves from the concrete sheet of signatures to the legal form, the act of asking, the asking verb, and finally the softer personal appeal.
sensesIntro.cn: petition 从一张签满名字的纸，走到法律文书、请求行为、请求动作，最后落到较柔和的个人恳求。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of signed pages handed to someone with the power to say yes.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠签了名的纸，被递交给有权说「好」的人。

branches.en: The signed sheet is the most concrete sense and the public face of the word.
branches.cn: 签名的纸是最具体的义项，也是这个词最公开的一面。

branches.en: The court copy makes the same request official and single.
branches.cn: 法院里的那一份把同样的请求变成官方而单一的形式。

branches.en: The act sense names the asking itself rather than the paper.
branches.cn: 动作名词的义项指的是请求本身，而不是那张纸。

branches.en: The verb keeps the seeking direction, formal towards a body and humble towards a person.
branches.cn: 动词保留「寻求」的方向：对机构正式，对个人谦卑。

branches.en: Paper, act and verb form one loop: people write, they ask, and the asking continues.
branches.cn: 纸、行为与动词构成一个循环：人们写下来，去请求，请求继续进行。

intro.en: Petition is built on the Latin root pet- and the noun suffix -ion, with -er and -ary extending the family.
intro.cn: petition 由拉丁词根 pet- 与名词后缀 -ion 构成，-er 与 -ary 又把词族向外延伸。

latinIntro.en: Latin petere means to seek, and its noun petitio means a seeking or a request.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 petere 意为寻求，其名词 petitio 意为寻求或请求。

items.example: The root pet- gives the whole family its direction.
items.exampleCN: 词根 pet- 给整个词族定下方向。

items.example: Petere is the verb behind the noun.
items.exampleCN: petere 是这个名词背后的动词。

items.meaningCN: 表示行为或结果的词尾
items.example: The suffix -io turns seeking into a named act.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -io 把「寻求」变成一个有名称的行为。

items.example: Petitio is the direct Latin noun.
items.exampleCN: petitio 是直接的拉丁名词。

items.example: The suffix -ion carries petitio into English.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ion 把 petitio 带入英语。

items.example: The suffix -er forms petitioner.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 构成 petitioner。

items.example: Petitioner names the person behind the request.
items.exampleCN: petitioner 指请求背后的那个人。

items.example: The suffix -ary forms petitionary.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ary 构成 petitionary。

items.meaning: of the nature of a petition
items.example: Petitionary describes pleading language.
items.exampleCN: petitionary 描述恳求性的措辞。

items.meaning: a strong desire, especially for food
items.example: Appetite shares pet- and means a seeking towards food.
items.exampleCN: appetite 同源，表示对食物的寻求。

definition_zh: 制药的；医药品；药物
definition_en: connected with the production of medicines, or a medicine made and sold by a company
core_image: 一排排针剂与药片在流水线上被装进药盒，贴上严谨的标签
scene: 实验室里，科研人员正在追踪一种新化合物的成分。The company spent years testing a new pharmaceutical that lowers blood pressure.
sceneCN: 这里 pharmaceutical 是「药物、药品」（第 2 个义项：由制药企业研发生产并出售的药剂）；句意：那家公司花了很多年测试一种能降血压的新药。

pos.zh: 制药的；医药的；药物学的

derivatives.zh: 由希腊语 pharmakon 经法语 pharmacie 而来，指「药房；药学」
pharmacy 加 -ist，指「药剂师」
pharmaco- 加 -logy，指「药理学」，研究药物的作用
pharmacology 加 -ical，指「药理学的」

senses.title: Relating to the making and selling of medicines
senses.definition: connected with the business of producing or selling medicines on a large scale
senses.definitionCN: 与大规模生产或销售药品这一行业相关的
senses.example: The region has welcomed foreign investment in the pharmaceutical industry.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区对外国投资制药业持欢迎态度。
senses.why: Greek pharmakeus named the maker of medicine, so pharmaceutical first describes the whole trade built around that maker.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 pharmakeus 指制药者，因此 pharmaceutical 首先描述围绕制药者建立起来的整个行业。

senses.title: A medicine produced by a drug company
senses.definition: a medicine made and sold by a company, usually in the plural in trade and news writing
senses.definitionCN: 由企业生产并出售的药剂，在行业与新闻报道中常用复数
senses.example: Cheaper versions of the same pharmaceutical reached the market.
senses.exampleCN: 同一药物的廉价版本进入了市场。
senses.why: The adjective became a noun when speakers needed a short word for products of the industry, so the medicine itself is now called a pharmaceutical.
senses.whyCN: 当人们需要一个简短词来指行业的产物时，形容词就转化成了名词，于是药品本身也被叫作 pharmaceutical。

senses.title: Of or concerning pharmacy as a science
senses.definition: relating to pharmacy as the science of preparing and testing medicines
senses.definitionCN: 与配制药剂、检验药物的药学科学相关的
senses.example: Her pharmaceutical training includes drug quality testing.
senses.exampleCN: 她的药学训练包括药物质量检验。
senses.why: Because the root connects to pharmacy as a science, the word also names the academic and technical side of medicines.
senses.whyCN: 由于词根与作为科学的 pharmacy 相连，这个词也指药物的学术与技术一侧。

intro.en: Pharmaceutical comes from Greek pharmakon, a drug or remedy, through the noun pharmakeia and the adjective pharmakeutikos.
intro.cn: pharmaceutical 源自希腊语 pharmakon（药物、疗法），经名词 pharmakeia 与形容词 pharmakeutikos 而来。

items.en: Pharmakon means a drug, a remedy, and in some texts also a poison or a charm.
items.cn: pharmakon 意为药物、疗法，在某些文本中也指毒药或符咒。

items.en: Pharmakeia means the use of drugs, and pharmakeus names the one who prepares them.
items.cn: pharmakeia 指使用药物的行为，pharmakeus 指配制药物的人。

items.en: Latin borrows the Greek forms as pharmacia and pharmacum, keeping the medicinal meaning.
items.cn: 拉丁语以 pharmacia 与 pharmacum 借入希腊词形，保留了药用含义。

items.en: The adjective pharmaceuticus appears in medical and scholastic writing.
items.cn: 形容词 pharmaceuticus 出现在医学与经院学派的著述中。

items.en: French pharmaceutique spreads the adjective in early modern European science.
items.cn: 法语 pharmaceutique 让这个形容词在近代早期的欧洲科学中传播开来。

items.en: English pharmaceutical starts as an adjective and later becomes a noun for medicines.
items.cn: 英语 pharmaceutical 起初是形容词，后来也用作名词指药品。

note.en: Pharmaceutical stands with its Greek pharmakon family and with the ordinary words for medicine in English.
note.cn: pharmaceutical 与希腊语 pharmakon 词族站在一起，也与英语中普通的「药」类词相邻。

entries.definition: a shop where medicines are prepared and sold, or the science itself
a person trained to prepare and sell medicines
the scientific study of how drugs work
a substance taken to treat or prevent illness
a substance used as a medicine or one taken for its effect on the mind
a treatment that cures or relieves a disease

normalIntro.en: Pharmaceutical is the hand that makes medicine at scale: pharm- is the drug, -aceous is the long professional tail.
normalIntro.cn: pharmaceutical 是那只规模化制药的手：pharm- 是药，后面的词尾是长长的专业尾巴。

normal.en: Pharmaceutical company is the standard partner: the word rarely travels alone in business news.
normal.cn: pharmaceutical company 是最标准的搭配：在商业新闻里，这个词很少单独出现。

normal.en: The Greek pharmakon gave pharmacy, pharmacist, and pharmacology, so the four words move together.
normal.cn: 希腊语 pharmakon 生出 pharmacy、pharmacist 与 pharmacology，这四个词一起行动。

normal.en: As a noun it is usually plural: pharmaceuticals are the products, not one tablet.
normal.cn: 作名词时常为复数：pharmaceuticals 指一批产品，而不是单独一粒药。

normal.en: Spell it as pharm plus maceutical: keep the ph at the start, the way Greek did.
normal.cn: 拼写分成 pharm 与 maceutical：开头保留 ph，和希腊语一样。

normal.en: Compare medicine: medicine is the everyday word, pharmaceutical is formal and industrial.
normal.cn: 对比 medicine：medicine 是日常词，pharmaceutical 更正式、更行业化。

abstract.en: Picture a long production line where white tablets fall into an endless row of boxes.
abstract.cn: 想象一条长长的流水线，白色药片落进望不到头的一排排药盒。

abstract.en: Imagine a small white bottle with a printed label standing on a glass shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象一只贴着印刷标签的小白瓶立在玻璃架上。

abstract.en: Think of a classroom of students in white coats weighing powder on a balance.
abstract.cn: 想象一屋子穿白大褂的学生，在天平上称量药粉。

examples.en: The pharmaceutical industry must test every new product before sale.
examples.cn: 制药业必须在销售前检测每一样新产品。

examples.en: Several pharmaceuticals on that shelf are produced in the same factory.
examples.cn: 那个货架上的好几种药物都产自同一家工厂。

examples.en: She studied pharmaceutical science before working as a quality inspector.
examples.cn: 她先学药学，后来做了质量检查员。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「法马修体贴」——药厂按法规把药修整得十分体贴，即制药的、药品；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 pharmakon（药物、疗法）→ pharmakeia（用药）与 pharmakeus（制药者）→ 形容词 pharmakeutikos → 拉丁语 pharmaceuticus → 法语 pharmaceutique → 英语 pharmaceutical。同一词根还生出 pharmacy、pharmacist、pharmacology；pharmakon 兼指毒药与解药，这一「双面」含义是常见讨论点，更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Pharmaceutical begins as an adjective for the medicine trade, then names the products of that trade, and also covers pharmacy as a science.
sensesIntro.cn: pharmaceutical 先作为制药行业的形容词，继而指这一行业的产品，最后也覆盖作为科学的药学。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rows of ampoules and tablets moving along a production line into labelled boxes.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排排针剂与药片沿流水线进入贴好标签的药盒。

branches.en: The adjective first describes the industry that turns the root drug into a business.
branches.cn: 形容词义首先描述把这味药变成生意的行业。

branches.en: Once the industry exists, its output is shortened to the same word as a noun.
branches.cn: 行业一旦形成，它的产物就用同一个词作名词来简称。

branches.en: Pharmacy as a science keeps the academic, testing side of the same root.
branches.cn: 作为科学的药学保留了同一词根里学术与检验的一面。

branches.en: Industry and product are two ends of one line: the factory and the box it fills.
branches.cn: 行业与产品是同一条线的两端：工厂，以及它装满的盒子。

branches.en: Scientific testing stands between the industry and its claims of safety.
branches.cn: 科学检验站在行业与其安全承诺之间。

intro.en: Pharmaceutical is the Greek root pharmac- plus the adjectival ending -eutical, with pharmacy and pharmacology as close relatives.
intro.cn: pharmaceutical 由希腊词根 pharmac- 与形容词词尾 -eutical 构成，pharmacy 与 pharmacology 是近亲。

latinIntro.en: The Greek root enters Latin as pharmacum and pharmacia, then passes into European science.
latinIntro.cn: 这一希腊词根以 pharmacum 与 pharmacia 进入拉丁语，再传入欧洲科学。

items.example: The root pharmac- carries the whole meaning of medicine.
items.exampleCN: 词根 pharmac- 承载了「药」的全部意义。

items.example: Pharmakon sits at the base of the family.
items.exampleCN: pharmakon 位于整个词族的底部。

items.example: Pharmakeus is the maker behind the medicine.
items.exampleCN: pharmakeus 是药物背后的配制者。

items.meaning: relating to a craft or practice
items.meaningCN: 与技艺或实践有关的词尾
items.example: The suffix -eutikos builds the adjective of the trade.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -eutikos 造出这个行业的形容词。

items.example: Pharmakeutikos is the adjective ancestor.
items.exampleCN: pharmakeutikos 是形容词的直接祖先。

items.example: The suffix -al closes the English adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -al 收束了这个英语形容词。

items.example: The suffix -cy forms pharmacy.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -cy 构成 pharmacy。

items.meaning: a place or science of medicines
items.example: Pharmacy is the short form of the same root.
items.exampleCN: pharmacy 是同一词根的短形式。

items.example: The suffix -ist forms pharmacist.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 构成 pharmacist。

items.example: The form -logy forms pharmacology.
items.exampleCN: 构词成分 -logy 构成 pharmacology。

items.example: Pharmacology adds study to the drug root.
items.exampleCN: pharmacology 在药物词根上加了「学问」。
